description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'EmployeeOnLeaveSearchFilterParams' used for encapsulating search filter parameters related to employees on leave within the OrangeHRM Dashboard plugin. It extends a base 'FilterParams' class and provides properties for date filtering and accessible employee numbers, along with methods to get and set these properties.

classes.name: EmployeeOnLeaveSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering employee leave data, including date and accessible employee numbers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sort field 'employee.firstName'.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date used for filtering.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date used for filtering.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the list of accessible employee numbers.

methods.name: setAccessibleEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the list of accessible employee numbers.
